about_the_game:
Step into a world of strategy, risk, and reward!
In this unique blend of deckbuilding, crafting, and RPG elements, every choice matters – from the cards you play to the items you forge.

Collect & Upgrade Items:
Boost your stats, discover rare equipment, and craft them into even stronger gear.

Tactical Card Battles:

Every turn counts! Choose your attack, defense, or special cards and outsmart your enemies with the right strategy.

Crafting System:
Combine Items to create even more powerful new items that give you the edge in battle.

Shop & Rewards:
Expand your arsenal by purchasing cards and items, or earn them as rewards from victorious battles.

Unpredictable Events:
Take your chances – lucky outcomes grant valuable items, while bad luck can curse you with debuffs for your next fight.

Every decision shapes your path. Will you rise as an unstoppable champion – or lose it all with a single wrong move?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i3 Processor
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i7 Processor/Ryzen 1700+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX960+
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
